answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 44623 Country: India Title: Chilla and Chatti Question: Please tell me whether it is allowed or not to celebrate Chilla and Chatti the functions performed after the birth of a child after 40 and 21 days as per Islamic Shariah. Answer ID: 44623 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 521/512/N=1434) Such types of customs and traditions do not exist in Islam. Hence if these rituals are performed as a part of religion then it shall be unlawful and innovation (bid’ah). But if they are not considered a part of religion but they include non-Shariah things then too they shall be unlawful. These ongoing Chilla and Chatti etc contain non-Shariah elements; hence it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
